headline: Dangote Group Breaks Ground on $2.5 Billion Namibia Fuel Hub
summary: Aliko Dangote broke ground for a planned $2.5 billion fuel storage site in Namibia to serve as a distribution hub for southern Africa and lower petroleum prices for landlocked countries.
why: Aliko Dangote is Africa's richest person and heads the Dangote Group, which operates major refining infrastructure on the continent, impacting regional energy logistics and supply.

impacts.name: Namibia
impacts.why: The $2.5 billion fuel storage hub is being constructed in Namibia to serve as a regional distribution center.
